notes: The first «أبي ره» is the compiler's own father, written bare: a relation. The honorific «ره» is left out.
The bracketed «[عَنْ]» is an editor's insertion: left out.
The Imam written after «عن» («عن أبي عبد الله ع قال») stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); the name is kept as written (owner ruling 3).
